speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: This clinical picture of subacute cognitive decline, personality changes (paranoia), and focal neurological deficits (right leg weakness, ataxia) in a 44-year-old male is highly suggestive of a subacute neurodegenerative process such as Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease (CJD) or potentially a rapidly progressive autoimmune encephalitis.
